company_house.notes: The Company's small Tier 1 house: cream plaster, dark timber, grey stone base and corners, violet roof with one dormer and a chimney; a green-roofed porch on the door face (the porch roof is separate geometry, paint only the wall behind it). Short steps and a barrel by the door are props, not painted.

tavern.notes: Tallest building in the slice: two occupied storeys plus a third under the roof line, projecting upper room read through timber framing; the wine-red awning over the entrance is separate. One plain replacement door plank as repair history.

provisions.notes: Compact shop: selling bay opening on the door face (a wide counter opening beside the door), a side storage door on one side wall, one broad plaster repair patch.

repair_supply.notes: Broad low working building: WIDE double work doors 3.0 m wide on the door face, older grey stone base and corner quoins, one replaced door brace. Gerd's shop.

lodging.notes: Two-storey lodging house near the gate: cream plaster and timber, green roof, cream awning over the door (separate), wine banner beside the door (separate).

stables.concept: eurydica-arrival-ward-approved.png (Arrival Ward stables; no dedicated label)
stables.notes: Jeb's stables: timber-boarded walls over a low stone base, a wide 3.0 m stable opening on the door face, half-doors (stall doors) along the long walls, hay-loft hatch in the gable. Work-worn but maintained.

guard_shelter.notes: Small timber guard booth beside the gate, open counter window on the door face, a plain notice board (no writing) on a side wall.

store_shed.concept: eurydica-company-edge-approved.png (store shed at the expansion yard)
store_shed.notes: The Company's lean timber store shed: boarded walls, plank door, a patched roof of reused red and brown boards (the patchwork roof tile).

gatehouse.notes: The South Gate: pale grey dressed-stone gatehouse, ONE round-arched opening through the middle, small green roof above; the arch opening must stay fully transparent (players walk through it). Same painting on the north (city) face and the south (outskirts) face.

house_violet.notes: Generic residential house (reused and stretched for many lots): cream plaster, dark timber, violet roof, simple dark windows. Keep it plainer than the named buildings.

house_green.notes: Generic market-street house (reused): cream plaster, timber framing, green roof; the ground floor may show a closed shutter shopfront. Plainer than the named shops.
